detail.description:
Harness the power of space and embark on an epic journey of creative destruction with Solar Smash, the ultimate physics-based sandbox simulation game!

🌌 Simulate the Universe: Control the forces of nature and become a cosmic architect as you explore the boundless expanse of space. Craft and customize your own planetary systems, from the tiniest asteroids to massive gas giants.

🪐 Two Thrilling Game Modes:

Planet Smash: Annihilate planets and moons with over 50 different weapons! Choose from
